notes.title: Is That a Phone in your Pocket? Wet Dreams Dry Twice available on iOS & Android!
notes.content:
Oh, behave! 
Today, together with developer Crazybunch we are excited to announce the mobile release of our Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice. 

Now available on iOS and Android mobile devices, you can do more than just “swipe right” on our titular heartthrob. Take Larry’s love quest on the go and help him explore the gorgeous Kalaua’a archipelago and uncover a deliciously devious plot, all while aiding in finding his one true love. 

Stranded on the island Cancum after the events of Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don’t Dry, Larry’s darling soulmate, Faith, has vanished without a trace, with the only clue to her whereabouts being a weak signal from her PiPhone. Journey through the tropical island paradise in the pursuit of true love, flexing those fingers (on the phone screen, naughty!) solving puzzles and meeting the locals along the way. Faced with an island of beautiful women, will Larry stay Faithful? Or will he give in to temptation? Your call, cupid <3

The sensational sequel to critically renowned Wet Dreams Don’t Dry, Larry Laffer is no stranger to praise — sitting pretty at 85% positive rating on Steam. Our man’s latest adventure also won 2020’s Adventure Game Of The Year award, receiving acclaim from both new and old point-and-click adventure fans alike. 

Watch the mobile launch trailer here: 
[previewyoutube=4y1wIJjCjm0;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/3819c3b68d64f617368209c97247caa75da6120a.jpg
 Explore the Kalaua’a archipelago with all its mysterious and magnificent islands — featuring over 50 beautifully hand-drawn locations.
 Meet over 40 new and old friends from Wet Dreams Don’t Dry and chat up some fresh new feminine friends.
 Help Larry solve difficult and exciting (and maybe a little erotic) new riddles and complete quests, providing him with a truly happy ending.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/cd3d66df2beb27e57c4eec6dcc0781c2c1d23ee5.jpg
To make up for his naughty behavior, romance expert Larry Laffer and Assemble have teamed up with ShareTheMeal to promote a ‘Save the World’ Edition of the title on PC here Steam. 
This edition contains the official soundtrack and digital artbook, with every purchase guaranteeing two meals for hungry children around the world. 

Larry’s amorous adventure sequel is also available on PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch.

notes.title: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice Out Now on Consoles!
notes.content:
The Long-Running Classic Franchise Finds Loveable Loser Larry Laffer Looking for Love...Again...on Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4

Everyone’s favorite polyester Prince Charming is bringing his search for love to the living room! 
Leisure Suit Larry: Wet Dreams Dry Twice, the latest award-winning entry in the long-running and beloved point-and-click adventure series, is now available on Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4! 
Together with developer CrazyBunch we have unleashed the endearing Lothario’s latest quest for companionship on consoles following the PC version winning “Best Classic Adventure of 2020” from the Adventure Game of the Year (AGOTY) Awards. 
From the comfort of your family room to your morning commute on the subway, there’s never been a better time to jump into Larry’s world and see why players have been enjoying his escapades for the last four decades. 

About Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice
In Leisure Suit Larry: Wet Dreams Dry Twice, you will need to guide our plucky protagonist through more than 50 beautiful, hand-drawn locations, meeting hilarious characters new and old, and solving cheeky, and sometimes deviously naughty puzzles along the way. 
Currently enjoying a “Very Positive” review metric on Steam following a successful run on PC, console Casanovas can now join the adventure and see why fans and point-and-click enthusiasts have been following Larry’s misadventures for nearly 35 years.

Watch the Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice console release trailer: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6AaTW7zWuTo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/3819c3b68d64f617368209c97247caa75da6120a.jpg
 Optimized for Max Levels of Love: The team at CrazyBunch has been hard at work perfecting the game for a smooth and enjoyable console experience, providing Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4 owners the best possible version of the title.
 Who Doesn’t Love Larry?: Wet Dreams Dry Twice brings the saucy humour, cheeky puns, and sometimes blatant innuendos that fans of the series are after, along with tried-and-true Point-and-Click gameplay, beautiful art, and brilliant voice-acting.
 I Can Resist Anything Except Temptation: Although Larry is officially in love, he’ll still have to avoid falling for the wiles of more than 40 unique and loveable characters, some from his past, some brand new.

Published by Assemble Entertainment and developed by Crazybunch, Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice is now available on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch with digital store versions at $44.99 USD, and PlayStation 4 and Switch retail versions available for $39.99 USD. 
💡 When getting the digital Xbox One or Nintendo Switch version on the respective consoles digital stores, save yourself -20% off with an exclusive and time-limited launch-discount!

Players can also grab the Windows PC and Mac versions via Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373430/Leisure_Suit_Larry__Wet_Dreams_Dry_Twice/

notes.title: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice — Coming to Consoles May 2021
notes.content:
Curl that chest hair and polish up your best gold chain, because legendary ladies man Larry Laffer is headed to Xbox One, PlayStation 4, and Nintendo Switch on May 18, 2021, in Leisure Suit Larry: Wet Dreams Dry Twice.

Together with developer CrazyBunch we are more excited than Larry when English Leather cologne goes on sale, especially with the PC version winning “Best Classic Adventure of 2020” from the Adventure Game of the Year (AGOTY) Awards.

Watch the Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice console teaser trailer on YouTube:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DG8sRXETxHY


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/0dbae4d8ea06de63535ea07f3aedb1d73ff23baf.jpg
About Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice
Help Larry track down his missing soulmate, the lovely Faith, who has mysteriously disappeared in the tropical paradise of Kalau’a — now from the comfort of your couch or on the go!
Currently enjoying a “Very Positive” review metric on Steam and a successful run on the original love machine, aka the PC, Wet Dreams Dry Twice is everything the long-running and legendary adventure series is known for: a plucky protagonist, more than 50 gorgeous, hand-drawn locations to explore, new friends as well as beloved recurring characters from previous games, and of course, plenty of naughty puns and hilarious puzzles to solve.
“Wet Dreams Dry Twice was a big hit on the PC, and it’s our pleasure to finally share the even cheekier adventures of Larry with console players,” said Assemble Entertainment CEO Stefan Marcinek. “There’s a charm to this series that keeps players coming back again and again, and Larry’s latest quest might be his most important of all.”
In the events of the last game, our heartsick hero Larry Laffer found himself stranded in Cancum and ready to leave the single life behind. Unfortunately, one thing led to another and Larry’s true love and future wife (hopefully) Faith has disappeared somewhere amongst the sunny series of islands in the Kalau’a Archipelago. Can Larry avoid temptation and stay focused enough to find out what happened and reunite with Faith?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/3819c3b68d64f617368209c97247caa75da6120a.jpg
 Ho'i Hou Ke Aloha: Fans of the previous games as well as newcomers will find plenty to fall in love with (again) in Larry’s latest adventure as he treks across the stunning tropical archipelago of Kalau’a, brought to life with beautiful hand-drawn visuals.
 Cheeky Puns? We’ve Got Plenty: It wouldn’t be a Leisure Suit Larry game without a bevy of spicy jokes, suggestive visuals, and good ‘ol fashioned dirty punnery.
 One at a Time Ladies!: During his quest for love, Larry will be tempted and teased by more than 40 “fleshed-out” characters, some from his nefarious past, some brand new.

Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice will release on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch on May 18, 2021!

Players can also grab the Windows PC and Mac here on Steam.

notes.title: Larry Bares It All in New Video for Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice
notes.content:
Hold on to your butts — as Assemble Entertainment today released a brand-spankin’-new gameplay trailer for the upcoming point-and-click adventure, Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice. 
Launching on Windows PC and MacOS via Steam on October 15, Larry’s newest adventure sees the loveable self-proclaimed ladies man set sail on the high seas to reclaim his love! 

Larry Laffer can’t seem to catch a break, and this new gameplay trailer showcases some of his most noteworthy lovestruck fumbles and successes as he ventures to the edge of the world searching for Faith, his one true love...for now. 
There’s no telling where Larry might end up in this new adventure, but if one thing’s certain, it’ll probably include a gimp suit. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JMq4xPmeWvY


More about Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice 
Hey ladies, it’s time to return to Larry-town! 
This may come as a surprise to some, but I am still going strong! That’s right, I’m a real stamina stallion! I left New Lost Wages, got stranded in Cancum, and had prepared to marry my only true love, Faith. But unforeseen events interrupted us and we’ve become separated again! 
She is somewhere in the famous, sunny, and huge Kalau’a archipelago and I have to find her. Help me! If I don’t find her soon, I think I may burst! 

No obstacle will keep me away from my beloved, my Faith, not even the wild and untamed islands of Kalau’a. Those lovely island ladies can only distract me for so long as my heart’s compass only points in one direction - Faith!. Care to set sail with me as a true pirate and become a real gold digger? Join my crew on this glorious tripper — you may just end up soaked to the bone!

Features:
 Explore the Kalaua’a archipelago with all its mysterious and magnificent islands — featuring over 50 beautifully hand-drawn locations
 Meet over 40 new and old friends from Wet Dreams Don’t Dry and chat up some fresh new feminine friends
 Help Larry solve difficult and exciting (and maybe a little erotic) new riddles and complete quests, providing him with a truly happy ending
 Published by Assemble Entertainment and developed by Crazybunch, Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice will launch on Windows PC and Mac via Steam on October 15, 2020.

notes.title: Leisure Suit Larry: Wet Dreams Don’t Dry Launches on Xbox One
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32836174/cdd9e1a567709bdbf33c41fb0281873d6d476921.jpg

Today, publisher Assemble Entertainment is delighted to announce that Larry Laffer is back at it — again — and this time, he’s on Xbox One! 

The world-famous ladies man is now available for your gameplay pleasure in the Microsoft Store in the form of Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don’t Dry! Join Larry as he takes on the modern age — one explicit social media app at a time — to stumble his way to true love. 

The Xbox launch completes Larry’s multi-platform conquest as the infamous title stakes its claim on PC, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android, and now, Xbox One! 

Boasting a ‘Very Positive’ Steam review score, Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don’t Dry lands Larry Laffer smack dab in 2018 where he’ll navigate his way through modern technology and modern women. What does that mean for the grease-stained lovebird of the ‘80s? Only one way to find out! 

Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don’t Dry launches on Xbox One complete with a 25% limited-time discount and the Happy Ending Update — an expansion that serves as an epilogue depicting what happens after Larry’s dating misadventures that take place in the main game. 

That’s not all — players don’t have to wait long to get more Larry, as Assemble Entertainment and developer Crazybunch have just recently announced the sequel Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice, launching on PC via Steam on October 15, 2020.

Leisure Suit Larry fans attention!

Hey there Leisure Suit Larry fans!

We can proudly announce, that over two years of development our latest title "Deadly Days" is now fully released on steam and is accompanied by a major content update for new and old players.

Deadly Days is a zombie apocalypse rouge-lite in a pixel world. The game lets you rescue different survivors in proceduraly generated world. Every run is a completely new experience and lets you choose between a number of items, specializations as well as powers to make your fight against the zombie hordes easier.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 is now live!
notes.content:
Dear Larrys out there,

please find the following patch notes for patch 1.0.4


The inventory has been reworked and extended in order to improve the inventory's usability.

 An overlay, which explains the controls, will be displayed at certain points in the game (mouse controls and keyboard shortcuts).

 A caption "skip" has been added in order to highlight the skip-button (quiz).

 Fixed a bug, which let Larry die by the router power cord even after the Wi-Fi connection has been restored in Lefty's Bar. 

 Fixed a bug, which allowed Larry to obtain the Sleaze Wars figurine without having the dollar bill.

 Fixed a bug, which incorrectly displayed the Timber App with some resolutions.

 Fixed a bug, which made some players bisexual.

 Several minor bugfixes and improvements.

We hope you still enjoy Larry in his new adventure. Just let us know how you like the new improvements and you are still invited to give us your feedback about what we can still do better.

Thank you for your support and hope we see each other again soon (K)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is now live!
notes.content:
Dear Community,

update 1.0.3 is now available with a few quick fixes.

Changelog:
- Fixed a bug, which allowed players to obtain unlimited buckets in Cancum.
- Fixed a bug, which caused problems with several UI elements when changing to specific resolutions (e.g. ultra wide resolution).
- Updated some speechfiles which had incorrect or misleading content. Cébé now will tell the player the correct Timber score for entering the night club Hell's Pawn, which is 25.

Thank you for your support on LSL - Wet Dreams Don't Dry. We are still excited about your feedback, so please continue and let us know about your Larry Laffer experience.
